scripts.build: npm run build:functions && npm run build:web
scripts.build:emulator: npm run build:functions && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build --mode emulator
scripts.emulators: npm run build:emulator && firebase emulators:start --project demo-p1s-heat --only auth,database,functions,hosting
scripts.test: npm run build:emulator && node --test test/domain.test.mjs && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-p1s-heat --only auth,database,functions,hosting "node --test test/emulator.test.mjs"
scripts.test:browser: npm run build:emulator && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-p1s-heat --only auth,database,functions,hosting "playwright test"
